aboutGame.title: What is Evolve a Cell?
paragraphs: Evolve a Cell is a free-to-play Roblox experience by the group Splitline: Creative, created on 2026-09-26 and last updated 2026-10-13. You play a tiny cell in a pond full of hungry things: eat plants or hunt other cells including players, evolve by adding jaws, spikes, eyes, tails and more, shape and paint your own creature, and grow large enough to take down giant bosses. The developer describes it as inspired by Spore.

The official description documents the core actions above, but it does not list mutation names, costs, DNA values, stage names, boss names or codes. All values in this wiki beyond what the official Roblox page states are described as not documented rather than asserted. Gameplay-focused pages explain the documented parts and where to verify details in-game.

modules.name: Evolve a Cell Beginner Guide
modules.description: Get new players started with the documented core loop: eat plants or hunt other cells including players, shape and paint your creature, and work toward growing large enough to fight giant bosses.

highlights.detail: Practice movement first so you learn how your tiny cell handles in the pond.
Eat plants early; hunting other cells is riskier until you can survive encounters.
Avoid fights with anything larger than you and treat distance as a resource.
Bank your progress until you know what is actually killing you.
Watch your cell's health while learning, since other cells including players can hunt you.
End the run on purpose and bank your progress instead of gambling it away.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Evolve a Cell.

items.question: What is Evolve a Cell?
items.answer: Evolve a Cell is a Roblox experience by Splitline: Creative in which you play a tiny cell in a pond full of hungry things. You eat plants or hunt other cells including players, evolve by adding jaws, spikes, eyes, tails and more, shape and paint your own creature, and grow large enough to take down giant bosses. The developer describes it as inspired by Spore.

items.question: Is Evolve a Cell free to play?
items.answer: The official Roblox page does not list a price and the experience is playable on Roblox, so it is free to play as of the retrieved record. It supports up to 16 players per server and had about 2.3 million visits with roughly 5,000 players online when the record was retrieved on 2026-10-14.

items.question: What should I upgrade first in Evolve a Cell?
items.answer: The official description does not document upgrade order, costs or stats. Based only on the documented loop, start by securing food through plants or hunting other cells, then add and test parts such as jaws, spikes, eyes and tails to see what helps your runs most.

items.question: How do I evolve faster in Evolve a Cell?
items.answer: Keep to the documented loop: eat plants or hunt other cells including players, add parts as described, and keep growing toward giant-boss size. Exact fastest routes, multipliers and stage requirements are not documented by the developer.

items.question: Do Evolve a Cell codes exist?
items.answer: No working codes are documented in the official description. Do not trust generator sites or lists claiming guaranteed rewards. If codes are ever added, they would most likely be announced through the official Roblox page or the developer group Splitline: Creative.

items.question: How do I reach max evolution in Evolve a Cell?
items.answer: The official description does not document a max stage or exact growth requirement. It only confirms that you grow large enough to take down giant bosses after evolving with jaws, spikes, eyes, tails and more. Check in-game for current growth details and official sources for changes.
